page.overview:
Who is Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan?

Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan is a Murandian Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah. She was formerly the Amyrlin Seat.

Once serving as the influential yet unpopular Aes Sedai advisor to Andor and one of the strongest Aes Sedai in the White Tower, Elaida deposed and replaced sitting Amyrlin Siuan Sanche after it was revealed that she was plotting to protect the Dragon Reborn. Elaida's controversial seizure of power led to the White Tower Schism.

Although she finally managed to capture the rebel Amyrlin, Egwene al'Vere, she became unpopular among her own supporters for her hubris and arrogance, her failings against the Dragon Reborn and the Asha'man, and the growing sectarianism of the Ajahs.

During the Battle of Tar Valon, she was captured by the Seanchan, made damane, and given the name Suffa. In her absence, Egwene was raised to Amyrlin by the remaining loyalist sisters, leading to the reunification of the White Tower.
